purpose: Task-faithful C. elegans adapter pilot using the official Borzoi trunk
native_checkpoint_policy: load native trunk weights only; never compare native human/mouse output heads

adapter_architecture.reason: preserve the proportional crop when reducing the native 524-kb input to 131 kb

target.one_bp_endpoint: not available from this pilot; do not include in the Model B primary composite

pilot.training_policy: new 241-head adapter, frozen pretrained trunk for pilot feasibility
pilot.validation_policy: same fold-1 validation intervals and metric implementation as P17/P19 where the 128-bp endpoint is defined

not_claimable: native Borzoi human/mouse performance on C. elegans
interpretation.promotion_rule: Only a successful pilot with finite loss, valid 241-head output, I-V-only audit and reproducible validation may justify a larger I-V adapter matrix.
